# The parcel model in one place {#sec-ch01b}

Every solver of kintera works on the same object: a parcel, a list of amounts of gases and condensates together
with two thermodynamic variables. Chapters 3 to 6 each derive one solver. This chapter says, in one place, which
two variables each solver holds fixed, which conservation laws each step obeys, and which functions the solvers
share, and under which conditions the sharing makes the library self-consistent. If the deck gives a condensate's
evaporation and nucleation reactions the same saturation curve, the equilibrium found by the phase solver is the
fixed point of the evaporation kinetics. If the modules also agree on the reference temperature, the heat capacity
and the energy options, the latent heat released in a kinetic step is the one the energy solver uses. The sign convention used throughout is that of the code. `stoich[i][r]` is positive for the products of
reaction $r$ and negative for its reactants, and a vector of reaction extents $\xi$ changes the amounts by
$S\xi$.

| @sec-ch01b-shared | the one saturation evaluator and the one energy function the modules share, and when they agree | `src/thermo/log_svp.cpp`, `src/thermo/eval_uhs.cpp` |
